verdict.rationale: Anytype is block-based ("Composable blocks: text, databases, kanban, calendar & custom Types") and supports Markdown import/export, links, and templates, implying rich content blocks, but the evidence pack never explicitly confirms headings, callouts, tables, code blocks, embedded media, or keyboard-driven navigation speed in the editor. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading/callout/table/code-block support, embedded media handling, and keyboard-shortcut-driven editing speed, plus independent hands-on confirmation of editor performance.
